title: Step 1 - Feature Scaling in ML: Why It's Crucial for Data Preprocessing

cues.en: Instructor: Okay, my friends, are you ready for the final tool of our data pre-processing toolkit, feature scaling which will allow to put all our features on the same scale.
cues.zh: 各位朋友，準備好資料前處理工具箱的最後一項工具了嗎？特徵縮放，會讓所有特徵位於相同尺度。

cues.en: So that's the what, and let me quickly remind the why.
cues.zh: 這是它的作用，現在快速回顧原因。

cues.en: Why do we need to do this?
cues.zh: 為什麼需要這麼做？

cues.en: Well, that's because for some of the machinery models that's in order to avoid some features to be dominated by other features in such a way that the dominated features
cues.zh: 因為對某些模型而言，要避免特徵被其他特徵主導，導致較弱勢的特徵

cues.en: are not even considered by the machinery model.
cues.zh: 根本不被模型考慮。

cues.en: Now, you also need to be aware that we won't have to apply feature scaling for all the machinery models, just for some of them.
cues.zh: 不過，並非所有機器學習模型都需要特徵縮放，只有某些模型需要。

cues.en: Therefore, we won't include this in our data pre-processing template, which I will show you by the way at the end of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 因此，不會把它放進資料前處理模板；稍後課程結尾會展示模板。

cues.en: So we will just add this tool in the toolkit because indeed for a lot of machinery models we won't even have to apply feature scaling even if we have features taking very different values.
cues.zh: 我們只會把它加入工具箱，因為許多模型即使特徵數值差異很大，也完全不需要縮放。

cues.en: For example, if you already know a bit about the multiple linear regression model, you know that each variable is actually multiplied by a coefficient,
cues.zh: 例如，如果你已稍微了解多元線性迴歸，就知道每個變數在

cues.en: you know, in the linear regression equation.
cues.zh: 線性迴歸方程式中，都會乘上一個係數。

cues.en: And so, well, you know, if you have variables that take much higher values than others, well when learning the coefficients the coefficient will just compensate by taking small values
cues.zh: 所以，如果某些變數的值比其他變數大很多，模型學習係數時，就能用較小的係數

cues.en: for the variables that take high values, right?
cues.zh: 來補償這些較大的變數。

cues.en: We will explain this more in part 2, regression, but for now, just know that this is a tool that will be applied from time to time for certain machinery models
cues.zh: 第二部分迴歸會更詳細說明，現在先知道，這個工具只會在某些模型中

cues.en: but not all the time, as you will see in this course.
cues.zh: 偶爾使用，不是每一次都用。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And also in the previous tutorial, I actually told you that I was about to answer one of the most important questions or most frequently asked questions
cues.zh: 而且前一堂課，我提到要回答資料科學社群中最重要，或最常被問到的問題之一。

cues.en: by the data science community.
cues.zh: 也就是社群裡的常見疑問。

cues.en: And I will keep, of course, my promise I will answer this when it's time, meaning at around the middle of this tutorial.
cues.zh: 我當然會履行承諾，在適當時機，也就是這堂課中段回答。

cues.en: But no worries, all questions about feature scaling will be answered so that you have absolutely no confusion.
cues.zh: 不用擔心，特徵縮放的所有問題都會說清楚，讓你不再困惑。

cues.en: All right, so we have the what and the why, and now let's proceed to the how, meaning, how are we going to apply feature scaling?
cues.zh: 我們已知道做什麼、為什麼，現在來看怎麼做，也就是如何套用特徵縮放。

cues.en: And to answer this question, I'm gonna show you the following slide, which are the main two feature scaling techniques that indeed put all your features
cues.zh: 先看這張投影片，裡面是兩種主要的特徵縮放技術，能把全部特徵

cues.en: in the same scale.
cues.zh: 調到相同尺度。

cues.en: And these two techniques are first, standardization which consists of subtracting each value of your feature
cues.zh: 第一種是標準化，把特徵中的每個值，

cues.en: by the mean of all the values of the feature and then dividing by the standard deviation which is the square root of the variants.
cues.zh: 減去該特徵全部數值的平均數，再除以標準差，也就是變異數的平方根。

cues.en: And this will put all the values of the feature between around -3 and +3, right?
cues.zh: 這會讓特徵值大致落在 -3 到 +3 之間。

cues.en: All the different features, when you apply this transformation on all the features of your dataset, well, all your features will take value between around
cues.zh: 對資料集的全部特徵套用這個轉換後，每個特徵的值大致都會介於

cues.en: -: 3 and +3, so that's standardization.
cues.zh: -3 到 +3，這就是標準化。

cues.en: And then you have normalization, which consists of subtracting each value of your feature by the minimum value of the feature, and then dividing
cues.zh: 另一種是正規化，將每個值減去該特徵的最小值，再除以

cues.en: by the difference between the maximum value of the feature and the minimum value of the feature.
cues.zh: 該特徵最大值與最小值的差。

cues.en: And so since this is positive, this is positive and this is always larger than this.
cues.zh: 因為這裡為正、這裡也為正，而且分母總是比這個差值大，

cues.en: Well, that means that all the values of your features will become between zero and one.
cues.zh: 所以全部特徵值都會落在 0 到 1 之間。

cues.en: All right, so this will result in having values of features between -3 and +3, more or less.
cues.zh: 前者會讓特徵值大致介於 -3 與 +3。

cues.en: And this will result in having all the values of your features between zero and one.
cues.zh: 後者則讓全部特徵值介於 0 與 1。

cues.en: Now the question is also much asked by the data science community.
cues.zh: 接著又是社群常問的問題。

cues.en: Should we go for standardization or normalization?
cues.zh: 該選標準化，還是正規化？

cues.en: Well, we're gonna be here very pragmatic.
cues.zh: 我們採取務實的角度。

cues.en: Normalization is recommended when you have a normal distribution in most of your features.
cues.zh: 當大多數特徵呈常態分布時，講者建議使用正規化。

cues.en: This will be a great feature scaling technique in that case.
cues.zh: 在這種情況下，它會是很好的縮放技術。

cues.en: Standardization actually works well all the time.
cues.zh: 標準化則通常都能發揮效果。

cues.en: It will do the job all the time.
cues.zh: 都能完成工作。

cues.en: Therefore, since this is a technique that will work all the time and this is a technique that is more recommended for some specific situations where you have most
cues.zh: 既然標準化通常適用，而正規化比較建議用於某些特定情況，也就是大多數

cues.en: of your features following a normal distribution then my ultimate recommendation for sure is to go for standardization.
cues.zh: 特徵呈常態分布時，我最推薦的就是標準化。

cues.en: Because indeed this will always work, you will always do some relevant feature scaling and this will always improve the training process.
cues.zh: 因為它通常有效，能完成適當的特徵縮放，改善訓練過程。

cues.en: So I'm going to teach you this technique.
cues.zh: 所以接下來教你這個技術。

cues.en: I'm going to teach you on how to apply it on our matrices of features.
cues.zh: 教你如何套用到特徵矩陣。

cues.en: And I'm saying matrices of features because now we have two matrices of features which are X-train and X-test.
cues.zh: 我說「矩陣們」，是因為現在有兩個特徵矩陣：X_train 與 X_test。

cues.en: And since we understood in the previous tutorial that feature scaling must be applied after the split while you understand that we won't apply feature scaling on the whole matrix of features X
cues.zh: 前一堂課已了解，縮放必須在切分之後，所以不會對完整的 X

cues.en: but of course on both X-train and X-test separately.
cues.zh: 進行縮放，而是分別處理 X_train 與 X_test。

cues.en: And actually the scaler will be fitted to only X-train and then we'll transform X-test.
cues.zh: 實際上，縮放器只會對 X_train 做 fit，再用它轉換 X_test。

cues.en: You know, we'll apply feature scaling on X-test because indeed since X-test is something that we're not supposed to have during the training, but only after like when going in production,
cues.zh: 我們會縮放 X_test，但因為 X_test 是訓練過程不應取得、只有完成後，像正式部署時才會看到的資料，

cues.en: well, we're not allowed to fit our feature scanning tool on the test set right?
cues.zh: 因此不能拿測試集來擬合特徵縮放工具。

cues.en: By fitting the feature scanning tool on the test set that means that we're gonna get the mean of the whole set and then the standard deviation in the feature.
cues.zh: 如果對測試集做 fit，就等於使用測試集的平均數與特徵標準差。

cues.en: No, we don't have the right to do this because X-test is supposed to be something new and therefore we'll just get the mean of the values in X-train, then get the standard deviation of the values in X-train,
cues.zh: 這是不行的，因為 X_test 應該是新資料；所以只計算 X_train 的平均數與標準差，

cues.en: then apply this formula to transform all the values in X-train, and then apply that same formula but with the same mean, and send the deviation of the values in X-train to scale the values of X-test.
cues.zh: 先用這個公式轉換 X_train，再用相同公式，以及 X_train 的同一組平均數與標準差，縮放 X_test。

cues.en: It's really, really important that you understand this and this is once again to give some further elements of response to that previous question, should we scale before or after the split?
cues.zh: 這點非常重要，也進一步解釋了先前的問題：應該先縮放，還是先切分？

cues.en: All right, so now that we are all clear on this let's proceed to the implementation of the how, meaning, the implementation of feature scaling.
cues.zh: 現在都清楚了，就進入實作，真正套用特徵縮放。
